title: Geely's 2018 Stealth Acquisition via Equity Collar Derivative Engineering
primaryArchitect: Li Shufu / Zhejiang Geely Holding Group
spvEntity: Tenaciou3 Prospect Investment Limited (incorporated in Hong Kong / offshore)

stages.mechanism: Geely approached Daimler's management offering to buy newly issued shares at a discount to partner on EV & battery tech.
stages.outcome: Daimler rejected: 'We are satisfied with our existing shareholder structure and will not dilute existing owners. Shares can be bought on the open market.'

stages.mechanism: Geely established offshore SPV 'Tenaciou3 Prospect Investment Ltd'. Global banks (Morgan Stanley, BoA) systematically purchased physical Daimler shares and synthetic total return swaps (TRS) on secondary markets in small increments.
stages.outcome: Accumulated inventory across multiple prime brokerage trading books without crossing German individual reporting accounts.
stages.regulatoryTrigger: German WpHG disclosure triggers (3%, 5%) circumvented as ownership was held synthetically and dispersed across multiple banking legal entities.

stages.mechanism:
Geely structured a Zero-Cost Collar with investment banks:
1. Long Daimler Stock (~9.69%)
2. Bought Put Options (Floor price protection at ~90-95% of current price)
3. Sold Call Options (Capping upside at ~105-110% to finance the puts at zero net premium)
4. Collateralized Margin Loan: Banks provided ~80-85% Loan-to-Value (LTV) non-recourse margin loan because downside risk was 100% eliminated by the put options.
stages.outcome: Geely only needed ~$1.0B–$1.5B in equity capital to control a $9.0B block of shares. Chinese state lenders / offshore lines covered the remainder.
stages.regulatoryTrigger: Economic risk shifted entirely to derivative market makers without triggering public disclosure prior to physical delivery settlement.

stages.phase: Overnight Voting Rights Conversion & Regulatory Blitz (Feb 23, 2018)
stages.action: Physical Exercise of Equity Swaps & WpHG Disclosure
stages.mechanism: Over a single weekend, Geely instructed intermediaries to exercise synthetic rights, convert all derivatives into direct physical voting equity under SPV Tenaciou3, and filed a mandatory notification with BaFin and Daimler.
stages.outcome: Daimler's board and German regulators were blindsided on Monday morning: Li Shufu became Daimler's largest single shareholder overnight with 9.69%.
stages.regulatoryTrigger: WpHG Section 33 notification filed at 9.69% in one jump, bypassing prior market warning windows.

regulatoryLoopholesExploited.preFixLaw: Old German WpHG / EU Transparency Directive did not enforce real-time aggregation of cash-settled equity derivatives with physical holdings below 3% reporting thresholds.
regulatoryLoopholesExploited.postFixReform: BaFin tightened derivative disclosure rules in 2019/2020 requiring mandatory aggregation of cash-settled options, swaps, and synthetic collar holdings.

regulatoryLoopholesExploited.preFixLaw: German Foreign Trade and Payments Act (AWV) screening threshold was set at 25% voting rights for non-EU investors in 2018.
regulatoryLoopholesExploited.postFixReform: Germany progressively lowered the AWV screening trigger to 10% for critical infrastructure and key industrial technologies in 2020-2022.
